name: math::Quaternion::PreMultiplyNormalised (this = normalise(rhs * this); thiscall, returns this)
notes: Lane HQ. Hooked (not yet run in-game). Difftest Quaternion_PreMultiplyNormalised: 20,000 cases (random, unit, axis-aligned, zero, huge, tiny, infinite components; rhs aliasing this), the 16 bytes bit for bit and the returned pointer; slot 193's entry test (tests/static_init_h5.cpp) runs it on 400 rotations too. NaN inputs excluded: a NaN's payload survives through whichever operand of a commutative SSE op comes first (operand order is the compiler's choice, not behaviour; precedent tests/simantics_geometry.cpp); zero and inf inputs still make the default NaN on both sides. Mutants: x's cross terms swapped, w's subtraction regrouped: killed; y's first two products commuted and sqrtf for (float)sqrt(double) survived, both equivalent (IEEE addition is commutative; sqrt rounded to double then float equals the float sqrt).
